parts.text: An IGCSE class is investigating the reflection of light by a plane mirror. One student’s ray-trace sheet is shown in Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) In the first part of the experiment, a plane mirror is to be placed on line CD .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a normal to AB at point N , towards the top of the page. Label the other end of this normal L .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Two pins P 1 and P 2 are placed on line LN . Label suitable positions for P 1 and P 2 . [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The mirror is placed on line CD and the images of P 1 and P 2 are viewed from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 4.1. Two pins P 3 and P 4 are placed so that the images of P 1 and P 2 , and the pin P 3 all appear exactly in line with P 4 .
